the Considerations put the 95% interval of Spearman's ρ on 200 items at roughly ±0.1; at ρ near 0.75 it is about ±0.065 (0.68 to 0.81, Fisher z with the 1.06 factor), wider when validity exclusions shrink n. Corrected.

Clause B now fires on the first; repair restores the rule afterwards only by dated amendment, as before.

`dp_matches_closed_form_lossless` claimed DP optimum = grid floor of the energy-balance payload for every lossless pair; the drive spends energy in whole force quanta q = F_max·h/128, so the claim holds only with ⌊E/q⌋·q (exact on the worked case, 160 quanta; not for E = 200 J, h = 1 m). Restated. The scaling metamorphic relation omitted F_max and the payload grid (scaling E and masses alone moves the force cap). The kill-gate note no longer grants a repair cycle the register does not.
